name: Kashiwagi Ema
source:
A girl with a cool personality who has many female fans, and due to this she is nicknamed "Prince." She likes cute things, but due to her reputation and role as a prince she keeps it a secret. Also [url=/c81785]Kotoha's[/url] childhood friend.

"Sense of touch" manipulated through hypnotism.
